description: A shell script for configuring iOS app signing settings, including team ID detection, bundle ID normalization, and generating a local configuration file with signing parameters.

methods.name: sanitize_identifier_segment
methods.description: Sanitizes a raw string to a safe identifier segment by converting to lowercase, replacing non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens, and trimming hyphens.

methods.name: normalize_bundle_id
methods.description: Normalizes a bundle ID string by converting to lowercase, replacing invalid characters, and ensuring proper format.
